items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they were saying, “okay, well let’s hook up some kind of date” ... So Peter didn’t have a lot to worry about…

ctx.x: Peter. And they were saying, “okay, well let’s hook up some kind of date” and I don’t know at what point we realized it was my birthday was coming up at the same time. So they said, “Why not make it a birthday bash for you?” And so it worked out really well because there was a grant to help pay for all of that, the big band and everything. So Peter didn’t have a lot to worry about…
